changes_made.explanation: Normalized dataset names to consistent format. Removed detailed Transformer specifications as they are variants of the core Transformer model. Removed technical metrics (FLOPs, speedup) from outputs since they are not generated text outputs. Added BLEU scores as they are evaluation metrics for the generated translations.
BLEU is correctly identified as the automatic metric used for evaluating machine translation outputs.
The paper does not use LLMs as judges for evaluating generated outputs.
The paper does not conduct human evaluations of the generated outputs.

overall_notes: This paper is primarily about model pruning techniques for neural networks, with machine translation used as one of the evaluation tasks. The NLG evaluation aspect is limited to using BLEU scores for machine translation outputs. The paper focuses more on model compression and efficiency rather than comprehensive NLG evaluation methodologies.
